summary: For S3 hub storage, create a secret with s3-access-key-id, s3-secret-access-key, s3-bucket-name and s3-region, set spec.hub.storage_type: S3 and object_storage_s3_secret (hub.name for an existing hub), and restart the hub API pods for an existing instance.
questions: How do I configure Amazon S3 storage for automation hub on OpenShift?
S3 secret keys for automation hub
Switch an existing automation hub to S3 storage

answer_card.title: Hub on Amazon S3
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: test-s3
stringData:
  s3-access-key-id: $S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID
  s3-secret-access-key: $S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
  s3-bucket-name: $S3_BUCKET_NAME
  s3-region: $S3_REGION
```
```yaml
spec:
  hub:
    storage_type: S3
    object_storage_s3_secret: test-s3
```
Existing hub: set `hub.name` and run `oc -n $HUB_NAMESPACE delete pod -l app.kubernetes.io/name=<hub-name>-api`.
